inspection_before_declaration: Dataset documentation, CSV column names and first Albania winter-wheat record inspected; no group distributions or model comparison inspected.
qualifiers: Retain original qualifier, report winter and primary/secondary seasons separately; generic millet excluded because crop identity need not be foxtail.
eligibility: Mapped crop; unique Data.ID; finite planting/harvest medians in [1,365], finite tot.days in (0,365). Retain every eligible record; log all exclusions.
duration_metrics: Distance from reported total growing days to the continuous range of model lengths; report outside exact endpoints and with fixed half-bin / full-bin tolerance. This interval is a necessary duration envelope, not an exact monthly-bin schedule or predicted harvest-date error.
cold_diagnostic: Summarize source ndays.growing.season.below.0 where available; it is based on source interpolated climatology, not daily frost extremes. Exposure flags a missing winter-dormancy process, but does not assign an exact model-rejection rate.
grouping: Original crop and qualifier; report calendar-record and unique-location counts, no pixel replication or independent confidence intervals.
inference_limits: Modern regional calendars and source CRU summary climate are not ancient cultivars, exact point observations, held-out Earth climate calibration, or a full date/yield validation. No parameter tuning, adoption, F use or population update.
